what: Pressing a season button (Spring·Summer·Autumn·Winter) switches every photo slot on the page to that season at once — the current photo wipes away from the right in 1s (clip-path inset 0 100% 0 0), and beneath it the next photo slides in from 5% to the right and settles in place in 1s. The chosen season is remembered for that tab, and at first the season is picked by the current month

options.shift: Offset distance of the next section (%), default 5
options.start: Initial branch (data-key) — if none, remembered one → season picked by month → first branch
options.remember: Memory name (sessionStorage), default fx-season — an empty value means nothing is remembered
options.[data-fx-part=trigger]: Category button — data-key is the category name. The current category gets is-active · aria-pressed
options.[data-fx-part=item]: Photos layered in one cell by branch — branch name via data-key. The consumer gives the parent cell position:relative and a size.

use: …

from.where: shared.js season button c-season — js-season-item (is-season-view, is-season-view-moment, is-season-prev, clip 1s, translate −45% → −50%)

note: As in the original, it is offset in the cell center with left 50% · translate(−45%, −50%) and then moved by −50% (the part’s CSS sets the position within the cell). The original remembers the season in sessionStorage and starts by picking the moon (Nov to Feb is winter).
